about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I'm Nikhil Yadav, a BCA 2nd year student and an aspiring Data Analyst. I work with SQL, Python, and Power BI to understand data and find useful insights.
I enjoy solving problems using data and creating simple dashboards that make information easy to understand. I'm currently focused on building my skills through practice and real-world projects.
I'm looking for opportunities to learn, grow, and gain hands-on experience in data analytics.

projects.title: Blinkit Sales Analysis
projects.description: Performed end-to-end analysis of Blinkit sales data using Python to uncover trends in product performance, pricing, and outlet impact.
insights: Tier 1 & 2 outlets outperform Tier 3 in average sales
Pricing has a stronger impact on sales than item visibility
Supermarket Type 1 contributes highest sales volume

projects.title: Customer Analytics Project
projects.description: End-to-end customer behavior analysis using Python, SQL, and Power BI to identify trends and improve business decision-making.
insights: Built interactive dashboard for business insights

projects.title: Zepto SQL Data Analysis
projects.description: Analyzed e-commerce inventory dataset using SQL to extract business insights related to pricing, stock, and product performance.
insights: Identified top discounted and high-demand products
Found high-value items that are out of stock

projects.title: Spam Detection Using Naive Bayes
projects.description: Built a spam classification system from scratch using pure Python without any machine learning libraries.
insights: Implemented Naive Bayes with Laplace smoothing
Used log-space computation for numerical stability
